about: The lucky ball is missing before the robot match!

bolt.d: a robot, captain of the Iron Bolts

tw.r: Red robots race round and round, rrrrunning right to rule the road.
tw.l: Little Lola lifts a lovely ball, and it lands low in the left net.
tw.sz: Six zippy stars zoom and sizzle as the zebra sips Zoe's fizzy juice.
tw.sh: Shy chicks chase shiny shoes and shout, wishing the cheese was cheaper.

x: Match day!
Tomorrow we play the Iron Bolts!
Captain, tomorrow is the big match against the robots, the Iron Bolts! Let's get our star ball!
No ball!
Oh no! The star ball is not on the shelf!
I flew all round: not on the shelf, not under the bench! The ball is gone!
Where is it?
It brings us luck!
Our star ball has brought us luck for three years! We need it. Let's search!
A seed on the floor.
A black seed is lying on the floor.
Captain spots something tiny on the floor: a shiny black seed. Where did it come from?
Locked up!
Zippy's locker is locked. Say the password!
Zippy's locker is locked with a password, and it may hide a clue! Say the password!
What now?
Where shall we look for the ball?
There is one seed but many paths. Do we follow the seeds or ask the neighbours?
More seeds!
There is a trail of seeds! Come on!
Look, a trail of black seeds! It goes all along the path!
It smells of melon!
Nobody saw the ball, but it smells of melon!
The neighbours did not see the ball, but the whole street smells of watermelons. Strange, isn't it?

end: What are these seeds and where do they lead? We will find out tomorrow!

card.d: Brings luck. But now it is hiding!

x: Seeds in a row!
The seeds lie in a row all the way to the street.
Buzzy zooms along the path: the seeds lie in a neat row, as if someone dropped them on the go.
It's melon!
These are watermelon seeds! Melons went by here!
These are watermelon seeds! So a cart full of watermelons came this way.
I see tracks!
Wheel tracks are left on the ground!
Look: stripes from wheels, and next to them a round dent. It looks like a ball mark!
A cart and a box.
Round the corner stands a cart with a box.
Round the corner stands an empty cart. A box with a lock is tied to it, and the lock says: "Say the password."
Box is shut!
The box on the cart is shut. Say the password!
On the cart is a box with a code lock: it opens if you say the password! Say it.

q: Whose seeds were on the path?

x: What next?
What shall we do next, Captain?
The box holds a note: "We take melons to the market." Do we run to the market now, or call Coach first?
Run to market!
Run to the market before lunch!
Quick, to the market! Melons are sold before lunch, and we must find the ball in time!
I'm with you!
I'm coming! But first a warm-up!
Coach Zippy is already tying his laces. "I'm coming! But first a warm-up, or my legs will sulk!"

end: What waits for us at the market?
The market is big, with hundreds of melons. How will we find our ball among them?

card.d: It drives slowly but drops seeds fast.

x: Run, team!
Warm-up! Run to the market, march!
A warm-up on the way! In a real match, eleven players play for each team, so we need strength!
I'm quick!
I'm quick! I have six legs!
I'm the smallest, but I have six legs! A goalkeeper must catch fast, and I will!
Pass, pass, pass!
We run and pass to each other!
We pass a sock instead of a ball: pass, pass, pass! A good team plays together.
I see the ball!
I see the star ball among the melons!
Stop! Among the green melons lies a round thing with a star. That is our ball!
Ball in a net!
The melons are under a net. Say the password!
The melons are covered by a net with a magic lock. Say the password to get the ball!
What to say?
How do we get the ball back?
The ball rolled into the cart by mistake and was brought to the market. What shall we do?
It's our ball!
Sorry, this is our star ball!
Sorry, this is our star ball, not a melon! It rolled into the cart by mistake.
Ball and melon!
Coach buys a melon, and we take the ball!
Coach Zippy laughs and buys a melon for the team: the ball is found, time to celebrate!

end: Who is rumbling by our stadium?
The ball is found! But someone huge is coming to the stadium, rumbling like a hundred pans. Who is it?

card.d: Six legs, and all run after the ball.

x: I am Bolt!
I'm Bolt! We will win! Beep-boop!
I am BOLT, captain of the Iron Bolts. Our chance of winning: a hundred percent. Beep!
Don't worry!
Easy! He is just a show-off!
Easy, Captain! Bolt likes to boast, but he plays fair. Let's answer with a tongue twister!
Word battle!
I challenge you to a tongue twister battle! Beep!
I challenge you to a tongue twister duel. Whoever says it faster and clearer picks half the pitch. Beep-boop!
One, two, three!
I'm the judge! One, two, three, go!
I'm the judge! We take turns, and a slip loses a point. One, two, three, go!
Say it fast!
Battle! Say the twister clearly!
The tongue twister battle has begun! Say it clearly and fast, and Bolt will see who he is playing.
How to answer?
How do we answer Bolt?
Bolt talks very fast, like a robot. Do we answer faster or clearer?
Clear! Beep!
Clearly said! My parts are humming!
Clear and neat! My chips are delighted. But we will still win the match! Beep-boop!
Oh! Beep?
Fast! My gears are stuck!
Fast! My processor got tangled in the sh-sounds. Sh-sh-beep! Fine, that was funny.

end: What will happen at the match?
The battle is over, and dark clouds suddenly gather in the sky. What will the match bring?

x: Match on!
Whistle! The big match begins!
Whistle! Eleven of ours and eleven robots run onto the pitch, and the ball rolls to the centre.
It's raining!
The first drops fall from the sky!
The first heavy drops fall from the sky, and the grass on the pitch soon gets slippery.
Squeak! Squeak!
Beep! My joints squeak in the water!
Beep-beep! Water got in my joints and they squeak like an old door. It is hard to run.
Match stop!
Stop the game! The robots need help!
Stop the game! The robots need oil, or their joints will rust. Let's help!
Umbrella, open!
We need a huge umbrella! Say the password!
A huge umbrella over the pitch opens only with a password! Say it before the rain gets stronger!

q: How many players does a team have on the pitch?

x: What first?
What do we do first?
What matters more first: cover the pitch with an umbrella or oil the robots?
Umbrella is up!
The umbrella opened! What a size!
A huge umbrella opened over the pitch, and everyone laughs: it is dry even by the farthest goal!
I'll oil them!
Oiling! With quick little legs!
I fly from robot to robot and quickly oil their joints. The squeaks fade! Next!

end: The rain fades, the robots shine, and the ball waits in the centre. Who will score first?

card.d: Covers the whole pitch and never leaks.

x: Play! Beep!
Beep-boop! Let's play fair, Captain!
Beep-boop! The Iron Bolts play fair. The match goes by the rules, and goals are won fairly!
I catch it!
I catch the ball! A goalkeeper may use hands!
I catch it! Only the goalkeeper may take the ball in hands, and only in their own penalty box!
We help!
Ball out! Let's help Bolt up!
Bolt slipped and fell. Captain kicks the ball out of play, and everyone runs to help.
Thanks! Beep!
Beep! Thanks for fair play!
Beep-beep! You stopped the game for me. That is fair play. Saving it in my memory!
Say it and shoot!
Power for the kick! Say the password!
The ball lies before the goal: say the password to shoot like a real champion!
How to finish?
How shall we end the match?
The scoreboard shows a tie. Do we play to the end, or invite everyone to play together?
A draw! Beep!
A draw! Three-three! That is fair!
Whistle! Three-three, a draw. Bolt pats a shoulder: "A fair score! Beep-boop!"
All together!
All together! Iron and paws!
Robots and our players mix and play together! The ball flies, and nobody counts goals.

end: Now the robots are our friends!
The star ball is back with the team, and the Iron Bolts are true friends now. What champions!

card.d: One cup for two teams. A draw is cool too!
